description: §7.6 rule (b) (S483 r1) — initializers inside `if=` content the compiler decides cannot trap: `/` by a number binding (1.0 / 0.0 is +∞), `%` by a non-zero literal const, a passing literal to a refined parameter — accepted and run.
rationale: §7.6 rule (b) (S483): "An initializer there that can trap SHALL be E-FILE-SCOPE-INIT-IN-CONSTRUCT" — it runs once, just before the construct, whether or not the construct shows (§7.6 R3), so the construct's test does not guard it. ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S482-trapping-construct-init — owner: "yes, interim refusal now and the feature later". Fix round r1 (#2129 review).
